region: US (operating subsidiaries in Germany / South Korea)

10k.note: OSR Holdings is a holding company. Drug-development subsidiaries: Vaximm AG (oral cancer immunotherapy platform, lead asset VXM01) and Darnatein Co., Ltd. (design-augmented biologics, lead asset DRT-102 for spinal fusion). Other subsidiaries: RMC Co., Ltd. (medical device distribution, Korea), and Woori IO (acquired Jan 2026, non-invasive glucose biosensing - early stage). On 21 Nov 2025 Vaximm out-licensed VXM01 globally to BCM Europe AG (largest shareholder) for $20M upfront (later upsized to $30M) plus up to $815M in milestones; BCME now controls VXM01 development.

website.note: osrhmed.com does not resolve; osrholdings.com landing is a JS redirect with no pipeline content. Pipeline detail derived from 10-K, ctgov, and Emerging Growth Oct 2025 initiation report.

ctgov.note: No trials sponsored by 'OSR Holdings' directly. Vaximm-sponsored VXM01 trials located via term search.

secondary_research.note: ClinicalTrials.gov term search returned 4 historical Vaximm-sponsored VXM01 studies (NCT03750071 P1/2 GBM Active not recruiting; NCT02718430 P1 CRC Completed; NCT02718443 P1 GBM Completed; NCT01486329 P1 pancreatic Completed). Phase 2a recurrent GBM final data reported 2024-2025. Larger Phase 2 / PoC and registrational Phase 3 trials planned for 2026 per company disclosures.
